seal.prompt: Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. Asset type: a genuinely transparent, independently rotating painted stone seal for the center of the gate in the reference website illustration. Image 1 is the exact world painting and medium to match; image 2 is a magnified reference of its central gate motif. Extract and reconstruct ONLY that stone gate wheel, not a circular crop of the scene. Deliver one centered, perfectly front-facing, circular but organically worn seal on genuine transparent alpha. The seal must be a tangible intricate relief carving: four wide cruciform arms carved into the face, clear connected continuous CROSS geometry as part of the wheel, terminating fully within its own sculpted outer rim. Retain a small central diamond and subdued antique-gold inlaid channels. Add carefully etched fine radial stone segmentation, shallow layered bevels, weathered chisel marks and broken engraved concentric contour lines; the main cross must remain very legible when the asset is only 48-60 pixels wide. Closely match the references' charcoal-grey watercolor stone, quiet warm ochre-gold, hand-painted ink outlines, paper-grain dry brush and subtle natural relief. This is an illustrated stone object, NOT a glossy 3D render, flat emblem, cropped photo disc, sci-fi button, glowing orb, or a generic gold coin. Soft low-contrast painted lighting without external cast shadow, bloom, drop shadow or bright rim glow. The entire cross, its small central diamond, the stone face and the rim belong to this single isolated rotating object. Do not include the surrounding gate, its vertical bright seam, doors, square background, mist or any scenery. No text, numerals, letters, logo or watermark. Keep the complete seal silhouette and all four cross arms inside the image with a small equal transparent margin; no cut-off details. Output a square transparent PNG.

brushes.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production texture atlas for luxurious hand-painted ink fireworks moving along curved contour paths in an illustrated fantasy website. Generate a genuinely TRANSPARENT PNG atlas, wide landscape 2:1, containing EXACTLY FOUR separate horizontal ink brush ribbons, one per equal-height row. These are complete long left-to-right brush STROKES, not brush tip stamps or isolated dots, and not radial fireworks. Each ribbon spans approximately 92 percent of the image width with a small transparent margin at both ends, stays within the middle 70 percent of its own row, and never touches any other row. The four ribbons are unique, carefully hand-painted, rich sumi-e / watercolor / ink on handmade paper pigment structures with tangible fine bristle tracks, broken dry-brush pores, crisp irregular pigment-deposit edges, wispy capillary bleeding, intermittent split filaments and visible pressure modulation along their whole length. Row 1: a sumptuous broad calligraphic stroke that begins fine, thickens into layered flowing dark pigment, and gracefully splits into several feathered tails. Row 2: a narrower continuous braided ink stream with elegant winding bristle lines and light translucent bleeds. Row 3: a dramatic broken dry-brush ribbon, several continuous dark filaments interwoven with negative-space paper channels, connected from left to right. Row 4: a delicate but long coherent wet watercolor stroke with beautifully frayed branching contour edges and subtle ink pooling. All four must read as exquisitely traversed moving brushwork rather than random splatter or simple flat rectangles. Neutral black and charcoal ink, transparent and translucent alpha only; no colored or white paper backing. The website recolors the ink to eight seasonal light/dark palettes. No stars, sparks, circles, flower/pinwheel explosions, dots as the primary motif, bokeh, neon, glowing gradients, borders, panels, text, labels, guide lines, numbers, logos, watermarks or rendered checkerboard. Keep every stroke fully visible with generous transparent separation. Flat orthographic scan, high-resolution material detail.
